Explaining on Instagram: "Leonardo DiCaprio finally won his first Academy Award for his role as Hugh Glass in The Revenant (2015). After years of critically acclaimed performances and multiple nominations, this win marked a long anticipated moment in his career.

In The Revenant, DiCaprio portrayed a frontiersman left for dead after a brutal bear attack, forced to survive extreme wilderness conditions while seeking justice. The role demanded intense physical endurance, minimal dialogue, and emotional depth, with much of the performance driven by raw survival rather than traditional storytelling.

His dedication to the role, including filming in harsh natural environments and pushing his physical limits, earned widespread praise. At the 88th Academy Awards in 2016, DiCaprio won Best Actor, cementing the performance as one of the most iconic and demanding of his career."
